Is the speedboat or big boat better for Ang Thong? | The speedboat (1,800 THB) is better for most people: the same stops in about 8 hours, back at your hotel by about 17:00. The big boat (1,500 THB, about 10 hours) is better if you get seasick, are pregnant, have back problems or want the lowest price.
Which Ang Thong tour is best for seasickness? | The big boat. It takes about 1.5 hours each way instead of one, but it rolls gently where a speedboat slams over the swell. Take a tablet 30–60 minutes before departure and sit low near the middle of the boat.
How long is the Ang Thong tour by speedboat? | About 8 hours door to door: hotel pickup 07:30–08:30, departure at 09:00, about an hour each way on the water, back at the pier at 16:00–16:30 and at your hotel by 16:30–17:30.
Is the national park fee included in the Ang Thong boat tours? | No, on every option, including the VIP and private boats. Bring 300 THB per foreign adult and 150 THB per child aged 3–14 in cash; under-3s are free, and the rangers collect the fee when the boat enters the park.
What is the Ang Thong VIP tour? | A shared day tour on a big speedboat with only 15 guests, for 4,500 THB per adult. It follows the speedboat route and timings, with more space, quicker landings, more time with the guide and fresh fruit added to the lunch.
Can young children do the Ang Thong tour? | Yes. Infants aged 0–2 travel free and children aged 3–11 pay the child price; children's life jackets are always provided and worn on the boat. The big boat or a private speedboat gives toddlers more room to move.
Can I book a private boat to Ang Thong? | Yes: a private speedboat costs 33,000 THB per boat for up to 10 guests, with captain, crew, guide, drinks, snorkel gear and kayaks. Lunch (400 THB per person) and hotel transfers (400 THB per person return) are optional.
Can I take either boat to Ang Thong in November? | No. The park is closed to all boats from 1 November to 15 December and reopens on 16 December. In that window, take the Pig Island speedboat (1,450 THB) or the Koh Tao and Koh Nang Yuan day trip (2,200 THB) instead.
